summary.text: Henry Hostetler is the Republican candidate for the North Carolina State Senate, District 5, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Kandie Smith (D).
Hostetler is the owner of the Baywood Racquet Club and a past president of the North Carolina Tennis Foundation.

paragraphs.text: Henry Hostetler won the March 3, 2026 Republican primary for District 5 with 83.3% of the vote over Angelene Mitchell.
Ballotpedia quotes his campaign website as saying his top priority is for District 5 to obtain its share of state funding and for senators to be known to their constituents.
